name: Karnataka Sustainable Data Centre Park near Hoskote
notes: State ministers approved a 1 GW three-city data park program; the Bengaluru-area park is described as a 500 MW sustainable data centre park near Hoskote, with solar power from Pavagada and 60 MLD treated water support.

name: NTT DATA Bengaluru 4 Campus
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Official NTT page lists the campus at 67.2 MW planned critical IT load across Bengaluru 4A/4B/4C. Trade press reported phase 1/BLR4A operational with 22.4 MW IT load and full buildout at 67.2 MW critical IT load; address evidence places the campus at Prestige Tech Cloud, Devanahalli/Bengaluru Rural.

name: Sify Bengaluru Aerospace Park Data Centre Campus
notes: Sify lists a Bengaluru data centre campus in Aerospace Park designed for 40+ MW of IT power. Aerospace Park is in the Devanahalli/Bangalore Rural airport corridor.

name: Nxtra Bengaluru II
notes: DCD reported Nxtra's upcoming Bengaluru II at 5,000 racks, 450,000 sq ft and 40 MW of power. Nxtra's current Bangalore page describes its Bangalore cluster as spread across Whitefield and Hoskote; district assignment to Bangalore Rural is inferred for the Hoskote facility.

name: Iron Mountain / Web Werks BLR-1 Bangalore Data Center
developer: Iron Mountain Data Centers / Web Werks
notes: Official Iron Mountain page lists BLR-1 in Pattandur Agrahara, Whitefield, with 80,000 sq ft and 4.1 MW total power capacity.

name: CtrlS Bengaluru Datacenter
notes: Official CtrlS page lists its Electronic City, Bengaluru Rated-4 facility with 2,000 racks, 106,536 sq ft built-up area and 13 MW IT power capacity.

name: STT GDC Bengaluru data centres
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres India
notes: Official STT GDC page lists Bengaluru locations with a combined 23 MW IT load: STT Bengaluru 1 at 0.6 MW, STT Bengaluru 2 at 4 MW and STT Bengaluru 3 in Whitefield at 18 MW.

name: Sify Bangalore Data Center
notes: Sify's Bangalore data center page lists 4.82 MW IT power for its purpose-built Bangalore facility.

name: CapitaLand Data Centre Bangalore 01 / CLDC BAN01
notes: CapitaLand lists a Bangalore data centre planned within International Tech Park Bangalore in Whitefield. Factsheet states 27 MW IT power capacity and 42 MW gross power capacity; capacity_mw records IT power.

name: Tulip Data City TDC Bangalore
developer: Tulip Telecom / Tulip Data Center Services
notes: DCD reported Tulip Data City opened in Bengaluru with about 0.9 million sq ft, 12,000 racks and 100 MW of power. Later directory sources describe available/sanctioned power differently; retained original announced power with note.

name: Nxtra Bengaluru I
notes: Nxtra's Bangalore page lists a Bangalore cluster highlight of 5.4 MW IT power and 2,000 racks; DCD separately described Bengaluru 1 as a 2,000-rack facility around 5.5 MW.

name: STPI Bengaluru Tier-III Data Centre
notes: STPI Bengaluru describes a Tier-III level data center with about 15,000-19,000 sq ft and 7,000 sq ft server farm area. Public source did not state MW capacity.

name: Karnataka Mangaluru Sustainable Data Park at Baikampady Industrial Area
notes: State data park program identifies about 350 acres of KIADB land in Baikampady Industrial Area, Mangaluru, for a data park. Total three-city program capacity is 1,000 MW, but Mangaluru-specific MW split was not stated.

name: Datasamudra AI-focused Mangaluru Data Centre
notes: Indian Infrastructure reported Datasamudra planned Rs 3-5 billion investment beyond Bengaluru, including a 35-40 MW AI-focused data centre in Mangaluru. capacity_mw records the upper end of the reported range.

name: Nxtra Mangaluru Edge Location
notes: DCD reported Nxtra has edge locations in Bengaluru, Hosur, Mysore and Mangaluru. Public source did not state MW capacity for the Mangaluru edge location.
